$comment: Curated notes for the MDS_EPD pharmacy distribution ERP. Loaded with SCHEMA_NOTES_FILE. Keep each note one short sentence; they are sent to the model.
dbo.InvoiceLine: Sales invoice header: one row per invoice. Sales totals come from here: SUM(net_amt) (after discount) or SUM(gross_amt) (before).
dbo.InvoiceLine.bId: Booking man (salesman) who booked the invoice; name is dbo.BookingMan.bName.
dbo.InvoiceLine.bkman_name: Free-text copy of the booking man name; prefer joining dbo.BookingMan.
dbo.InvoiceLine.inv_src: Where the invoice was created: MDS (this system) or QB (imported).
dbo.InvoiceDetail: Sales invoice lines: one row per product per invoice. Product-level sales: SUM(total_net) or SUM(sale_qty).
dbo.InvoiceDetail.total_net: Line amount after discount and tax, PKR.
dbo.InvoiceDetail.sale_qty: Units sold on this line (bonus units are in bonus_qty).
dbo.Customer: Customers (pharmacies, clinics, distributors). One row per customer; del = 1 means deleted.
dbo.Customer.catagory: Customer category code (R is by far the most common, used for retail).
dbo.Customer.cust_rec_balance: Amount the customer currently owes (receivable), PKR.
dbo.Product: Products. Key is (comp_id, group_id, prod_id): prod_id alone is not unique, always join on all three.
dbo.Company: Pharmaceutical companies (principals/suppliers) whose products are sold.
dbo.TblTown: Towns within areas. Key is (area_id, town_id): town_id alone is not unique; count towns with COUNT(*).
dbo.CashRecieved: Cash received from customers: one row per receipt; amt in PKR.
dbo.PurchaseLine: Purchase invoice header from companies: one row per purchase; netamount in PKR.
dbo.SalesReturnLine: Sales return header: one row per return; netamount in PKR.
dbo.StockDetail: Stock by batch: qty on hand and expdate (expiry) per product batch.
dbo.CusLedger: Customer ledger entries (dr = debit, cr = credit).
dbo.uvSaleInvoice: Report view with one row per invoice LINE; header amounts (net_amt) repeat on every line. Never SUM header amounts here; use dbo.InvoiceLine.
dbo.InvoiceView: Print view with one row per invoice LINE; header amounts repeat on every line. Use dbo.InvoiceLine / dbo.InvoiceDetail for totals.
dbo.QuoteView: Quotation print view, one row per line. Not sales.
dbo.uvSale: Report view with one row per invoice line (quantities S, Sb, Sr, Srb). Prefer dbo.InvoiceDetail.
